landing_hero_subtitle: A production-ready full-stack template with React 19, TanStack Start, Convex, and Better Auth. Type-safe, real-time, and ready to deploy.
landing_features_subtitle: Built with the latest technologies and best practices
landing_feature_auth_description: Email/password, OTP verification, password reset. Secured with rate limiting and anti-enumeration patterns.
landing_feature_realtime_description: Convex reactive queries that automatically update your UI when data changes. No polling needed.
landing_feature_ssr_description: TanStack Start delivers fast initial loads with server-side rendering and intuitive file-based routes.
landing_feature_typesafe_description: TypeScript strict mode, Zod validation, and Convex typed API. Catch errors at compile time.
landing_feature_ui_description: Base UI primitives with Tailwind CSS v4 and CVA variants. Dark mode included.
landing_feature_testing_description: Vitest + Testing Library with 80%+ coverage target. TDD workflow out of the box.
landing_feature_ci_description: GitHub Actions pipeline with lint, type-check, test, build, and bundle size tracking.
landing_feature_edge_description: Deploy to Cloudflare Workers for global edge performance. Zero cold starts.
landing_tech_subtitle: The best technologies for building production apps
landing_testimonials_subtitle: Join hundreds of developers building faster
landing_testimonial_1_quote: This template saved us weeks of setup. The auth system alone is worth it.
landing_testimonial_2_quote: Finally, a template that gets TypeScript right. End-to-end type safety is a game changer.
landing_testimonial_3_quote: The Convex integration is seamless. Real-time features just work.
